title: Writing all day, lost wives and keeping his hands together
summary: Mingus says writing cost him his wives, Sue keeps him working, and he needs it for his health.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: It's unbelievable, because all my aspirations of have so much energy so I can youth are gone, to (inaudible) write all day long, so I did. That's how I lost all my wives. I was writing music. So I'm supposed to be resting up now, but Sue's got me going again, with several different things. I get a little rest.
Well, you're pretty well a self motivated man, I think. I don't think anybody can get you to do something they don't want to do.
I feel I got to do it now, anyway, to keep my health, my hands, together.
Yeah, it keeps you from sitting around, feeling sorry for yourself. Give yourself some work to do. Nothing wrong with that.
